# Afterschool Agent
> On-demand training + weekly live Q&A where young people build a personal AI agent that teaches the eight essentials.
> https://www.afterschool.agency

## About
The Afterschool Agent programme teaches teens (13-23) to build a local-first AI companion using Hermes that guides them through the eight essentials of onetoeight — silence, body, scripture, nature, digital self-defence, life skills, community, and tested character. The agent also helps with homework, planning, and daily routines via a Morning Minute audio briefing.

## Key features
- On-demand training modules — self-paced
- Weekly live Q&A every Tuesday at 4:30 PM
- Fully secular — teen tailors the agent to their own beliefs
- Local-first: everything runs on the device, no cloud data
- Three daily rituals: Afterschool Chat, Planning Session, Morning Minute
- $44.88 one-time payment
- Requirements: personal laptop (8GB RAM), $5 OpenCode Go account, Telegram or WhatsApp
